title: Polar H10 Orthostatic HRV Drop Morning Check
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body/blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=polar:hrv measurement_type=orthostatic
stats latest(rmssd_ms) as rmssd by _time
streamstats window=7 avg(rmssd_ms) as baseline
where rmssd<baseline*0.85
description: Compares seated-to-standing Polar HRV readings against baseline for illness or overtraining signals.
value: Surfacing polar h10 orthostatic hrv drop morning check helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant health, sleep & wearables export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It frames when polar h10 orthostatic hrv drop morning check matters for your routine.
